claims.claim: DG CVn is a binary system whose two red dwarf stars orbit each other every 4.511 years and lie 59.3 light-years from Earth.
claims.episode_span: The two stars orbit each other every 4.511 years on an elliptical path that brings them as close as 0.59 times the Earth-Sun distance. The system lies 59.3 light-years from Earth.
claims.source_title: Astronomers track a flaring dwarf-star duo with exceptional precision
claims.supporting_quote: These observations show that the two stars orbit each other once every 4.511 years, following a stretched, elliptical path. At their closest approach, the stars come within about 0.59 times the distance between Earth and the sun. The system is relatively nearby, at 59.3 light-years from Earth.
